goalZh: 在候选级完整 LCI 尚未接入时，以透明、可编辑的情景清单比较 MOF 合成路线，并把环境负担、经济成本、数据准备度和不确定性分开报告。
goalEn: Compare MOF synthesis routes with a transparent, editable scenario inventory while candidate-level LCI is incomplete, reporting environmental burden, economic cost, data readiness, and uncertainty separately.
boundaryZh: 这是按 ISO 14040/14044 结构组织的筛选级情景模型，不是经同行评审或第三方审查的完整 LCA/TEA。候选缺少真实合成清单时，结果只能标记为“情景估算”，不得作为最终材料排名。
boundaryEn: This is a screening scenario model structured around ISO 14040/14044, not a peer-reviewed or critically reviewed full LCA/TEA. Without candidate-specific synthesis inventories, outputs remain scenario estimates and must not be treated as final material rankings.

functionalUnits.boundaryZh: 摇篮到工厂门：金属/连接体前驱体、合成、洗涤、活化；不含使用、设备、运输和报废。
functionalUnits.boundaryEn: Cradle-to-gate: metal/linker precursors, synthesis, washing, and activation; excludes use, equipment, transport, and end of life.

functionalUnits.boundaryZh: 在材料生产清单上增加再生电力，并用工作容量、循环次数和利用率分摊材料；不含捕集装置 CAPEX、压缩、运输和封存。
functionalUnits.boundaryEn: Adds regeneration electricity to material production and amortizes material through working capacity, cycles, and utilization; excludes capture-plant CAPEX, compression, transport, and storage.

inventoryReference.noteZh: 清单数量和价格是筛选代理值；所有结果必须显示不确定区间与替换路线。
inventoryReference.noteEn: Inventory quantities and prices are screening proxies; every result must expose uncertainty intervals and replacement paths.

routeScenarios.assumptionZh: 把常规溶剂热批式工艺作为相对基准；69% 产率仅来自已发表 TEA 的代表性 MOF-74 情景，需由候选真实工艺替换。
routeScenarios.assumptionEn: Uses a conventional batch solvothermal route as the relative baseline; 69% yield comes from a representative published MOF-74 TEA scenario and must be replaced by candidate-specific process data.

routeScenarios.assumptionZh: 用于检验少有机溶剂、高水耗/热负荷的方向性影响；倍数是可编辑情景假设，不是对任一候选的实测路线。
routeScenarios.assumptionEn: Tests the directional effect of low organic-solvent use with higher water/heat demand; multipliers are editable scenario assumptions, not measured routes for any candidate.

routeScenarios.assumptionZh: 用于检验少步骤、低溶剂路线的方向性收益；不能假定所有 MOF 都可采用该路线，必须增加合成可行性验证。
routeScenarios.assumptionEn: Tests directional benefits from fewer steps and less solvent; it cannot be assumed feasible for every MOF and requires synthesis validation.

inv_organic_linker.replacement: Replace with linker synthesis route or supplier EPD/LCI.

inv_solvent.replacement: Replace with solvent-specific production, recovery, and disposal LCI.

inv_electricity.replacement: Replace with the selected regional grid mix and reference year.

inv_heat.replacement: Replace with measured heat demand and fuel/utility pathway.

inv_water.replacement: Replace with local water supply and treatment inventory.

inv_waste.replacement: Replace with composition-specific solvent and solid-waste treatment.

economicModel.scopeZh: 材料、溶剂、公用工程和筛选级转化费用；不含正式 CAPEX、融资、税费、设备寿命和规模学习曲线。
economicModel.scopeEn: Materials, solvent, utilities, and a screening conversion-cost allowance; excludes formal CAPEX, financing, tax, equipment life, and scale learning.

serviceDefaults.noteZh: 这些是可编辑的服务情景默认值，不是 Open MOF Seed 的候选实测字段。
serviceDefaults.noteEn: These are editable service-scenario defaults, not candidate measurements from Open MOF Seed.

candidateDataGate.ruleZh: 准备度低于 75%，或产率、质量平衡、实测能耗、溶剂回收以及服务期性能等硬门控缺失时，只输出情景估算、热点和补数任务；不生成候选级环境优胜者。
candidateDataGate.ruleEn: When readiness is below 75%, or hard gates for yield, mass balance, measured energy, solvent recovery, or service performance are missing, report scenario estimates, hotspots, and data tasks only; do not name a candidate-level environmental winner.

sources.title: ISO 14040 / ISO 14044 life-cycle assessment standards
sources.roleZh: 目标与范围、LCI、LCIA、解释、报告与局限的结构。
sources.roleEn: Structure for goal and scope, LCI, LCIA, interpretation, reporting, and limitations.

sources.title: Life-cycle assessment as a tool for eco-design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs)
sources.roleZh: MOF-74 摇篮到门评价；强调合成、清洗溶剂热点。
sources.roleEn: Cradle-to-gate MOF-74 assessment highlighting synthesis and washing-solvent hotspots.

sources.title: Techno-economic Analysis of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Hydrogen and Natural Gas Storage
sources.roleZh: 大规模 MOF 生产成本、产率、溶剂用量、回收率和路线敏感性。
sources.roleEn: Large-scale MOF production cost, yield, solvent usage, recovery, and route sensitivity.

sources.title: Comparative life cycle assessment on zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) production for CO2 capture
sources.roleZh: 以 1 kg ZIF-8 为功能单位比较七种路线；DMF 清洗是主要热点，机械化学路线影响最低。
sources.roleEn: Compares seven routes per 1 kg ZIF-8; DMF washing is a major hotspot and mechanochemistry has the lowest impacts.

sources.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Metal-Organic Frameworks: Sustainability Study of Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-67
sources.roleZh: 比较 1 kg ZIF-67 的溶剂热与反应挤出路线，说明路线选择可跨数量级改变影响。
sources.roleEn: Compares solvothermal and reactive-extrusion routes per 1 kg ZIF-67, showing route choice can change impacts by orders of magnitude.

sources.title: Life cycle assessment of CO2 capture through pressure swing adsorption using MOF-74
sources.roleZh: 把生产、使用与再生纳入 MOF-74 捕集评价，并用敏感性/不确定性分析识别产率与捕集能耗。
sources.roleEn: Includes MOF-74 production, use, and regeneration, with sensitivity/uncertainty analysis of yield and capture energy.
